name: Warm Front
tagline: The field service software for people who actually turn wrenches.
positioning: Warm Front runs dispatch, invoicing, and maintenance contracts for HVAC owner-operators who'd rather be on a rooftop than in a spreadsheet.

hero.h1: Your dispatch board shouldn't be a whiteboard from 2004.
hero.sub: Warm Front schedules techs, chases invoices, and tracks every filter change so you can quote the next job instead of digging through your glovebox for a crumpled work order.

features.title: Dispatch that survives a heat wave
features.description: Drag jobs across techs, auto-route by drive time, and text customers a real arrival window instead of the classic 'sometime between 8 and 5.'

features.title: Invoices before the truck cools down
features.description: Techs bill on-site from their phone, tap for card or ACH, and the payment lands before they've finished coiling the hose.

features.title: Maintenance contracts on autopilot
features.description: Recurring PM agreements auto-schedule, auto-remind, and auto-invoice — the boring recurring revenue that keeps the lights on in January.

features.title: Every unit's history in one place
features.description: Scan the equipment tag and pull up model, refrigerant, warranty, and the last four visits — no more calling the office to ask what you did last spring.

features.title: Quotes that don't die in a text thread
features.description: Build good-better-best options with photos, send them by link, and watch when the customer opens it. Follow up like a closer, not a stalker.

features.title: Payroll that matches the timesheet
features.description: Clock-in, drive time, and job hours flow straight to payroll — so your bookkeeper stops doing detective work every other Friday.

testimonials.quote: We ran three techs off a paper calendar and a group chat. Warm Front cut our unbilled hours to basically zero. I found $9k in maintenance visits we forgot to invoice last year. Cool. Cool cool cool.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: My techs actually use it, which is the whole miracle. They hated the last app so much they 'forgot' their phones. Now they close jobs on-site because getting paid faster is a language everybody speaks.
testimonials.name: Marco Trejo

testimonials.quote: I switched from a platform that charged me like I was a Fortune 500. Per-seat pricing means I add my summer helper for a month and drop him in fall. No sales call, no drama.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the one-truck operation that's tired of doing books at midnight.
For shops with a few trucks and actual recurring contracts.
For multi-location operators who need controls, not chaos.

homepage.footerBlurb: Warm Front is field service software for HVAC owner-operators who'd rather fix the unit than fight the app.
